subject: Roundtable: Inference serving roadmap — multi-prospect session availability
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jane Liu <jane@olivedata.com>, Kevin Park <kevin@pinebridge.ai>, Maria Santos <maria.santos@aureliahealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roundtable: Inference serving roadmap — availability for multi-prospect session

Hi all,

Thanks for signing up for a multi-customer roundtable to walk through Redwood Inference's latest serving roadmap and a few customer patterns we've seen for latency/cost wins. The session will be collaborative — quick intros, a short demo, then a focused Q&A and breakout on integration patterns (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Proposed agenda (30–40 min):
- 5 min: quick intros
- 10 min: short demo: smart routing + cache demos
- 15–20 min: open Q&A / breakout for account-specific questions

We'd like to run one session next week and want to pick a time that works across everyone. Ben and Sofia will co-host the technical breakout. Can each of you reply with availability or pick a slot on this Doodle? https://doodle.com/poll/redsrv-roundtable

Quick notes:
- We'll record and share a short follow-up with configuration snippets.
- Attached: initial host runbook for the breakout (host_runbook.pdf).

Thanks — Connor

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: host_runbook.pdf (1.1MB)]

Connor — thanks for the invite. Pinebridge can do either:
- Wed May 22 between 10:00–11:00 PT, or
- Thu May 23 09:00–10:00 PT.

If you need a single pick, put us down for Wed May 22 10:00 PT. I'll loop in our infra lead if we need deeper config notes.

— Kevin

Thanks for the quick replies. To avoid back-and-forth, I've made a two-option poll (Doodle link above) but also put up two concrete session options here so we can lock one immediately:

Option A: Wed May 22 — 10:00–10:45 PT (goal: demo + light breakout)
Option B: Thu May 23 — 09:00–09:45 PT (goal: slightly longer breakout for infra questions)

If we get mixed votes, we'll prioritize the time that allows both hosts to be present — Ben flagged a conflict on Wed, so Option B is slightly preferred from our side. Please pick A or B or fill the doodle by EOD Thursday. I've attached an updated agenda and an .ics of the tentative Option B so you can slot it into calendars.

Agenda attachment: roundtable_agenda_v2.pdf
Calendar stub: connor_availability.ics

If Option B is best for you, we'll plan on a 45-minute session with a 15-minute breakout for account-specific dives. Bridge details and a short pre-read will follow once time is locked.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: roundtable_agenda_v2.pdf, connor_availability.ics]
